about.title: Trust Since 2013
about.intro1: Tengeriin Ilgeemj LLC was founded in 2013 and is the official distributor of ESTEL and SYNERGETIC brands in Mongolia.
about.intro2: The company operates across four main areas: Training Academy, Salon Trade & Services, Branded & Chain Stores, and Wholesale & Online Sales — with 14 branches in Ulaanbaatar, Darkhan, and Erdenet.
about.intro3: The ESTEL brand maintains permanent contracts with over 1000 salons, while SYNERGETIC is known for its 98.8% natural eco products. The company annually trains over 500 professional hairdressers, continuously contributing to industry development.
